findings.claim: Spec scope says the advisory defect is cured by the bump so array bounds are out of scope, and the changeset presents the bump as the remedy for unbounded-array issue accumulation; zod 4.6.6+ caps only size-constrained collections (capSize, v4/core/schemas.js:820-840), so unbounded arrays still accumulate one issue per failing element
findings.counterexample: 200000 failing elements: z.array(z.string()) gives 200000 issues on 4.6.5 and on 4.6.7; .max(10) gives 200001 vs 1; z.record gives 200000 on both; 173 of 177 totem z.array sites carry no .max on the line

findings.claim: The published MCP inputSchema of all four tools (add_lesson, describe_project, search_knowledge, verify_execution) loses additionalProperties false under zod 4; undisclosed; the wire error issues also lose received and gain origin
findings.counterexample: listTools via in-memory client: v3 inputSchema.additionalProperties=false, v4 undefined, for tools 0-3; runtime strip and rejection unchanged

findings.claim: Every parsed result is unchanged is falsified: v4 .datetime() rejects minute-precision instants and offset:true rejects colon-less offsets that v3 accepted, reachable via totem legs deposit --read-at into LegDepositSchema.readAt; the exported DoctorConfigSchema.parse(undefined) also changed
findings.counterexample: LegDepositSchema with readAt 2026-11-02T19:00Z: v3 success, v4 Invalid ISO datetime; datetime offset:true on 2026-01-01T00:00:00+0530: v3 true, v4 false

findings.claim: TotemConfigSchema narrows on numbers: z.number() rejects Infinity (cacheTtls) and .int() rejects values above MAX_SAFE_INTEGER (numCtx), both accepted by v3
findings.counterexample: cacheTtls {a: Infinity}: v3 OK, v4 invalid_type; numCtx 2**60: v3 OK, v4 too_big

findings.claim: The design lists the run-artifact schemaVersion message and the uuid-to-guid acceptance as invariants locked by tests, but no test pins the run-artifact refine text and no test pins off-RFC acceptance at the two selection-manifest guid sites
findings.counterexample: grep finds no test text for unsupported run-artifact schemaVersion; selection-manifest.test.ts has no off-RFC session_id or pointer_session_id case

findings.claim: Two claims are imprecise: zod 4.6.7 keeps a runtime v3-compat single-argument z.record (only the TS signature dropped it), and openai is also imported in cli openai-orchestrator.ts, not only in the core embedder; conclusions hold
findings.counterexample: zod/v4/classic/schemas.js:1024 v3-compat branch; z4.record(z4.string()).safeParse({a:'x'}) succeeds; packages/cli/src/orchestrators/openai-orchestrator.ts:26 await import openai

findings.claim: The design says the two issue-path joiners stringify segments, but issue.path.join remains at core legs.ts:532, cli utils.ts:170 and cli legs.ts:481; v4 emits a symbol path for a symbol-keyed record input; convert for consistency or note as unreachable from JSON and YAML?
findings.counterexample: z4.record(z4.string(), z4.unknown()) on an object with a symbol key yields an invalid_key issue whose path is that symbol

verdict: blocking=1 material=2 minor=3 question=1; convergence named on the migration's mechanism (record keys, prefault, the DoctorConfigSchema default drop, partialRecord, guid, error maps, type edits): no regression in 18437 on-disk records, 38 config cases or 198 schemas over base inputs; the open findings are claim breadth, the published MCP schema, and format narrowing outside the five mechanical classes
